entries.zh-Hans: 气力由全队共用，内力由每名角色各自持有。出牌前先看费用；气血归零的角色会退场，护甲用于抵挡伤害。
entries.en: The party shares Energy, while each character has their own Inner Power. Check a card's costs before playing it. A character leaves battle at zero Health; Armor absorbs damage.

entries.zh-Hans: 悬停敌方意图，查看招式、目标与实际数值。按即将到来的攻击安排护甲、格挡、援护或治疗。
entries.en: Hover over an enemy intent to inspect its move, target and current values. Prepare Armor, Block, Cover or healing for the incoming action.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择一张可用手牌，再点合法目标；无需选目标的牌会直接使用。右键取消选目标。悬停卡牌，Shift看详述，Ctrl看术语。
entries.en: Select a playable card, then choose a legal target. Cards that need no target are played directly. Right-click to cancel targeting. Hover over a card; use Shift for details and Ctrl for keywords.

entries.zh-Hans: 完成本回合操作后结束回合，让敌方按意图行动。下个玩家回合会补充资源和手牌；结束前留意收招与回合末效果。
entries.en: End the turn after your actions to let enemies carry out their intents. Resources and cards refill on the next player turn. Check Finisher and end-of-turn effects before ending.

entries.zh-Hans: 选择当前能够到达的节点。节点类型决定战斗、商店或其他遭遇；点过的位置会留下墨圈。
entries.en: Choose a currently reachable node. Its type determines the battle, shop or other encounter. Selected positions keep an ink-circle mark.

entries.zh-Hans: 左上显示当前关卡、行程和可用行旅钱。行旅钱用于局内商店，不能用局外金币代付。
entries.en: The top left shows the current stage, route progress and available Travel Coins. Route shops use Travel Coins; Gold cannot be used in their place.

entries.zh-Hans: 右侧只保留图标和短名称。把鼠标放到对应行查看完整说明；悬停图例标题可查看墨圈和淡色状态的含义。
entries.en: The right side shows icons and short names. Hover over a row for its full explanation, or over the heading to learn what ink circles and faded nodes mean.
